entries.displayName: Throttle Background Store App CPU Activity
entries.description: Suppresses background CPU cycling from non-essential UWP store apps while preserving critical notification brokers.
Disables slow window minimize and maximize animations for crisp desktop responsiveness.

entries.displayName: Limit Windows Delivery Optimization Background Bandwidth to 20%
entries.warning: Caps peer background download bandwidth so Windows Update does not saturate internet connections.

entries.displayName: Disable Windows Welcome Experience Suggestion Prompts
entries.warning: Stops full-screen tips and suggested feature promotions from showing after Windows updates.
Enforces automatic TRIM command issuance upon file deletion on solid-state drives.

entries.displayName: Configure Standard Keyboard and Cursor Input Blink Interval
entries.warning: Standardizes cursor blink frequency to eliminate UI redraw jitter.
Automatically restarts Windows Explorer if the desktop shell hangs or crashes.

entries.displayName: Enable Storage Sense 30-Day Recycle Bin Automated Purge
entries.warning: Directs Storage Sense to automatically clean files left in the Recycle Bin for over 30 days.
Disables background cloud profiling used to send targeted promotional experiences.

entries.displayName: Prevent Secondary Disk Spindown During Active AC Use
entries.warning: Exposes disk idle spindown timeout power controls and eliminates Explorer spin-up hangs.
Locks DWM hardware composition on modern display adapters for stutter-free window movement.
entries.name: Disable DWM Glass Colorization Overhead

entries.displayName: Clamp Kernel Crash Dumps to Small Minidump (256KB)
entries.warning: Prevents catastrophic multi-gigabyte kernel dump generation on unexpected stoppage.
Disables desktop window acrylic transparency blur to eliminate GPU composition overhead.
Prevents Windows Software Quality Metrics client background logging and uploads.

entries.displayName: Disable Bing Web Search in Windows Start Menu
entries.warning: Restricts Start Menu searches strictly to local files and apps, eliminating cloud query lag.

entries.displayName: Set Delivery Optimization Maximum Cache Age to 7 Days
entries.warning: Automatically purges peer-to-peer Windows Update files older than 7 days to preserve free drive space.
Stops legacy LMHOSTS file lookups and NetBIOS name broadcasts on local subnets.

entries.displayName: Set Windows Insider Service (wisvc) Startup to Manual
entries.warning: Stops background Windows Insider evaluation telemetry from running on normal production builds.

entries.displayName: Set Optimize Drives Service (defragsvc) Startup to Manual
entries.warning: Ensures drive defragmentation and TRIM operations only start on demand during scheduled system maintenance.

entries.displayName: Set Cellular Time Sync to Manual
entries.warning: Prevents cellular network time polling on systems using Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
Halts background microphone wake-word listening threads.

entries.displayName: Optimize Explorer Folder Type Discovery Cache
entries.warning: Prevents slow metadata scanning of large directories containing media files.
Prevents automatic association with unverified public open Wi-Fi hotspots.

entries.displayName: Enable Automated Purge of Unused User Temporary Files
entries.warning: Directs Windows Storage Sense to automatically reclaim drive space occupied by stale user temporary files.

entries.displayName: Throttle Windows Error Reporting Disk Dump Spikes
entries.warning: Restricts pending error reporting queue length to prevent disk saturation during multiple crashes.

entries.displayName: Set Smart Card Removal Policy Service to Manual
entries.warning: Eliminates background polling for non-existent corporate smart card readers.

entries.displayName: Enforce AC Standby Power Budget Limits
entries.warning: Constrains modern standby background execution to protect thermal headroom.
Prevents Windows from waking sleeping PCs for routine maintenance tasks.

entries.displayName: Configure System Working Set Cleanup Threshold
entries.warning: Calibrates Windows memory manager working set cleanup to trigger when load exceeds 80%.
Runs folder windows in a unified desktop thread for reduced memory consumption.
entries.name: Taskbar Thumbnail Preview Response Time

entries.displayName: Set Device Association Broker to On-Demand
entries.warning: Allocates device pairing daemon memory only when wireless pairing is active.

entries.displayName: Collapse Taskbar Search Box to Clean Search Icon
entries.warning: Collapses the bulky taskbar search box into a clean icon to reclaim taskbar space and reduce background web rendering.

entries.displayName: Disable Windows Start Menu Most-Used App Launch Tracking Telemetry
entries.warning: Stops Windows from recording app launch frequencies and building telemetry usage histories in the registry.

entries.displayName: Configure Crash Dump Filter to Kernel Minidump
entries.warning: Standardizes crash dump output to small 256KB minidump directory.
Disables deprecated transition tunnel protocols without impacting native IPv6.
Disables taskbar news feeds and background widget network polling.

entries.displayName: Restrict Delivery Optimization Background P2P Upload
entries.warning: Prevents Windows Update from using user Internet bandwidth to upload updates to external peers.

entries.displayName: Enable Windows Storage Sense Automatic Cleanup
entries.warning: Enables automated background cleanup of temporary cache files when storage is low.

entries.displayName: Configure Background Camera Access Policy to Require Consent
entries.warning: Requires apps to request permission before silently accessing webcam hardware in the background.
Disables automated background transmission of software crash reports to Microsoft.

entries.displayName: Show Known File Extensions in Windows File Explorer
entries.warning: Unhides file extensions in File Explorer for transparent verification of executable types and enhanced security.

entries.displayName: Eliminate Window Foreground Focus Switch Delay (ForegroundLockTimeout = 0)
entries.warning: Prevents background processes from stealing focus and ensures immediate focus switching to the active window.
Reclaims disk space equal to physical RAM (hiberfil.sys) on permanent desktop PCs.

entries.displayName: Set Sensor Service (SensorService) Startup to Manual
entries.warning: Configures physical orientation sensor monitoring service to on-demand manual start on desktop PCs.
Reveals file extensions for security and system transparency.
